question: Can an independently published temporal SCM dataset supply version-specific true paired counterfactual trajectories and heldout causal structures with independently authenticated source provenance and no hidden/source-label leakage?

evidence_pins.license: Apache-2.0 code; repo registry claims dataset CC-BY-4.0, independently recheck archive

source_audit_rules: Do not use version='latest' or a concept DOI as exact version identity; require exact release version, per-file provider hashes and complete raw manifest before any original trial.
v1.0.0 independent-noise twin pairs cannot serve as per-episode counterfactual targets; an interventional population mean is not an individual counterfactual.
v1.1.0/1.2.0 declared shared-noise pairing is a necessary format signal only; verify actual bytes and pre-intervention paired equality independently.
v1.2.0 appends nonidentified bow_graph; observation-only predictions on that class must abstain unless independently sufficient public intervention signal exists.
Exclude hidden SCM generator, true graph, intervention-outcome future labels, postintervention x_int and hidden U from permitted model public FIT inference features.

Do not cherry-pick evaluation after seeing effects, no CHECK/heldout choice, and no reuse of original first-use; the public frozen suites are only potential public development or an externally authorized source, never automatically fresh original science.

A source producer's release cannot independently attest untouched scientific first-use; existing CKB-plane authority must freeze source/cohort & independent holdout and admit one genuine original if eligible.

decision_thresholds.source_only: Can admit to bibliographic preflight for public development only
decision_thresholds.original_science: BLOCK unless released exact bytes and independently witnessed first-use and paid/resource/peers gates qualify

next: Run deterministic source-only metadata/version test and retain true/false positives; then audit provider-side per-file raw hashes and nonidentified-family splits before even considering public source download under separate authority.
